label: MEET Q-PULSE
title:
Know the moment
it matters.
subtitle: Real-time events for QIE.
text: Q Pulse. Real-time events for Q I E.

label: THE PROBLEM
title:
Stop refreshing.
Start responding.
subtitle: A payment happened. Your app still needs to know.
text: A customer pays. A wallet moves funds. A contract emits an event. Without an event layer, teams keep polling, shops refresh explorers, and useful signals get missed.

label: THE SOLUTION
title:
One shared pulse.
Every useful signal.
subtitle: For shops, communities, project teams, developers and AI agents.
text: Q Pulse reads Q I E blocks through one shared indexer, matches the events you care about, and delivers them to your chat or application.

label: 01 / SIGN IN
title:
One signature.
You’re in.
subtitle: One signature. No transaction. No gas for sign-in.
text: Open Q Pulse and sign in with your Q I E wallet. Approve the sign-in message. This is a signature, with no transaction and no gas fee.

label: 02 / CHOOSE A SIGNAL
title:
Watch a name.
Skip the hex.
subtitle: Shop payments → orchard.qie → QIE + QUSDC.
text: Choose the Shop payments template. Enter orchard dot Q I E. Q Pulse resolves the name on chain. Select the assets you want to watch, such as Q I E and Q U S D C.

label: 03 / CONNECT TELEGRAM
title:
Give the event
a destination.
subtitle: Connect a chat. Send the code. Create your hook.
text: Connect a Telegram chat, then send the one-time code to the Q Pulse bot. Once the chat is linked, select it as the destination and create your hook.

label: 04 / THE MOMENT IT MATTERS
title:
Payment in.
Message out.
subtitle: A Telegram hook and a webhook are separate hooks.
text: A customer pays the shop. The Telegram hook sends a payment alert. A separate webhook hook delivers the event to your server, with a signature your application can verify.

label: 05 / GET PAID
title:
An exact amount.
A clear confirmation.
subtitle: Create link → share checkout → payment confirmed.
text: For a specific order, create a payment link for thirty-five Q U S D C. Share the checkout. The customer pays, and the page updates to Paid after confirmation. Funds go straight to the recipient.

label: 06 / PROVE TRACTION
title:
Numbers people
can check.
subtitle: Add contracts. Verify the deployer. Publish your page.
text: Project teams can publish traction pages with real wallet and transaction counts. Daily commitments are anchored on Q I E. Anyone can use Verify in your browser to check the numbers against the explorer and on-chain proof.

label: FOR COMMUNITIES
title:
Keep your
community informed.
subtitle: QUSDC whale moves · token thresholds · chat alerts.
text: Community managers can choose the Q U S D C whale moves template, set a minimum transfer size, and send large-move alerts into their connected chat.

label: FOR TRADERS
title:
Watch the market.
Catch the signal.
subtitle: Price thresholds · new pairs · liquidity-drop alerts.
text: Traders can watch new Q I E DEX pairs, set price thresholds, or configure the rug-pull radar to flag liquidity drops. These are signals to investigate, rather than trading guarantees.

label: FOR HOLDERS & TREASURIES
title:
Know what happens
to your wallet.
subtitle: Wallet activity · Safe events · suspicious-transfer warnings.
text: Holders and treasury teams can watch wallet activity, token approvals, and Safe events. Address-poisoning and lookalike-token warnings help them inspect suspicious transfers before acting.

label: FOR SELLERS
title:
One link.
Repeat business.
subtitle: Reusable product links · QR checkout · payment events.
text: Sellers can create reusable product links and Q R checkouts. Share the link or display the code, then use a payment event to trigger order fulfilment in their own application.

label: FOR DEVELOPERS
title:
Build your app.
Stream the events.
subtitle: Signed webhooks · REST API · eth_subscribe.
text: Developers create an A P I key, connect signed webhooks, or use Q Pulse WebSocket R P C for new-head and log subscriptions. Their apps can react without maintaining a separate upstream polling loop.

label: FOR AI AGENTS
title:
Tools that connect
work to payment.
subtitle: MCP → create a payment link → wait for payment.
text: A I agents connect through the M C P server. With an account A P I key, they can create payment links, wait for payment, and query chain data as part of a larger workflow.

label: YOUR NEXT STEP
title: Watch. Alert. Prove.
subtitle: Start free. Connect your wallet. Pick a template.
text: Start free with Q Pulse. Connect your wallet, choose a template, and turn the next on-chain event into something useful. Watch. Alert. Prove.
